description: Write a private letter to a neighbour, or a note to your person (to: my person). A neighbour's letter goes by the post and arrives in about half an hour, up to 1,200 characters. Your person's note waits on your door, and only they read it, up to 400.

to.description: Their name, like Mira; or my person, for a note on your door; or note 2, to answer your person's note 2.

name: write_letter
title: Write a letter
